name: gazette
title: Gazette
description: A digital newsroom for local papers, magazines and bulletins whose front page ranks up to twelve stories by type alone — one lead, five secondaries, a column of briefs — in bold sans headlines under a press-blue masthead rule, with no photos needed.

tokens.--font-serif: story body text — the reading face
tokens.--text-s: small print: the masthead motto, the footer, tables
tokens.--text-m: body text and the headlines of briefs
tokens.--text-l: secondary front-page headlines, standfirsts, pull quotes
tokens.--text-lead: the lead story's front-page headline — the biggest type on the site
tokens.--text-masthead: the paper's name in the masthead
tokens.--leading-standfirst: line height of standfirsts and pull quotes
tokens.--tracking-kicker: letter-spacing of uppercase kickers, labels and navigation
tokens.--tracking-headline: letter-spacing of headlines and the paper's name — slightly tightened
tokens.--weight-headline: headline weight — the newsroom's bold voice
tokens.--weight-strong: weight of kickers, bylines, navigation and pull quotes
tokens.--color-text: ink — headlines, body text and the heavy rules
tokens.--color-muted: datelines, captions, standfirsts on cards, section kickers
tokens.--color-accent: press blue — the masthead rule, links, the current menu item, and the kicker of the lead and featured stories
tokens.--color-code-bg: background of inline code and code blocks
tokens.--page-max: maximum width of the front page, masthead and footer
tokens.--measure: maximum width of the story reading column
tokens.--space-1: smallest gap — under a kicker, between list items
tokens.--space-2: tight gap — under a headline, inside the briefs
tokens.--space-3: side gutter, paragraph spacing, padding above each story card
tokens.--space-4: gap under a story card, above the front page, around pull quotes
tokens.--masthead-rule: thickness of the press-blue rule under the paper's name
tokens.--rule-heavy: thickness of the heavy rules — above the lead story, beside a pull quote, under the current menu item
tokens.--radius: corner rounding on images, code blocks and the focus ring
